colorRoles: Use neutral off-brand colors for the broken assistant UI.
Reserve stronger contrast for payment failure and blocked states.
Use Lucius purple only as a restrained closing-tag quality cue.
typeRoles: Use sans-serif only in the negative example UI.
Use one strong headline layer with restrained support labels.
Keep any Lucius closing tag secondary.
radiusRules: Use soft, consistent rounded corners across chat and payment surfaces.
Do not mix incompatible corner languages.
backgroundRules: Use a warm neutral background with quiet depth.
Keep the background restrained so the proof element remains dominant.
graphicLanguage: Use clean SaaS UI surfaces and minimal chrome.
Avoid decorative clutter or joke framing.
motionTone: Motion should feel quietly confident and readable.
The final proof state should end in a dead-stop hold.
prohibitedPatterns: No flashy AI magic or glitch spectacle.
No competing animated elements on the same screen.

alreadyInRepo: Case-level product context and design guideline
CSS/React project template for browser-first short assets
optionalEnhancements: Real payment UI screenshots if an exact product-specific checkout needs to be recreated later
Real copy wording from the target product if legal or brand review requires exact phrasing
Additional icon or illustration references if a stronger SaaS marketing treatment is desired
uiReferences: Current generic support chat treatment in the existing asset
Current payment panel composition already built in the initial browser/video proof version
copyDependencies: Final approval of short on-screen lines if a stricter brand voice pass is needed
